# X-Center ID SDK

The upstream repository distributes its JavaScript packages as tarballs built with `npm pack`. The packages here came from SDK commit `57c4930abe34003dfb74923ec823ef6245a985ce`. The project lockfile records their integrity.

- [Server and data client installation](https://github.com/Xarber/xcenter-id-sdk/blob/57c4930abe34003dfb74923ec823ef6245a985ce/docs/DATA_CLIENTS.md)
